CustomField.description: Position-restricted skills: empty = every staff member can see and use this skill. Filled = only staff whose Contact.Current_Position__c is one of these values can see it (Library, @ list, Required picker) or receive it (router, @ mention, load_skill/search_skills, subagents). Shares the TCCFO_Positions global value set with Contact.Current_Position__c, so renamed/added positions appear in both (rename with "Replace", not an API-name edit). Read by the LiteLLM proxy within 10 minutes. Always Include and Proxy Injected skills can't be restricted (validation rule Restricted_Skill_Must_Be_Plain_Text), and no other firm skill may require a restricted one (Apex + validation rules). A packaged skill may be restricted: the code sandbox copies its files only for these positions (cfo-sandbox-mcp cfo/071).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave empty for everyone. Pick positions to limit who can see and use this skill, matched to the staff member's Current Position on their Contact. Always Include and Proxy Injected skills can't be restricted, and no other skill may require a restricted one.
CustomField.label: Restricted to Positions
